niche_preference_profile: This user most consistently prefers interfaces that feel calm, polished, and well-structured: clear hierarchy, coherent grouping, complete and populated content, restrained decoration, and balanced spacing. They repeatedly favor layouts with strong organization, readable sectioning, and a refined visual rhythm over fragmented, noisy, unfinished, or overly ornamental screens. They also show a recurring preference for softer, more controlled color treatment and calmer emotional tone, though their preference for light vs. dark themes and some header styles varies by context.

criteria.description: Prefers screens with obvious headline-to-body-to-action structure, readable section labels, and a logical top-down flow rather than fragmented or competing emphasis.
Prefers content organized into clearly separated sections, cards, rows, or bands with consistent patterns and strong categorical rhythm rather than mixed modules or weak boundaries.
Prefers interfaces that feel filled out, intentional, and content-rich, with visible items and finished sections rather than sparse, empty, or incomplete screens.
Prefers minimal ornamentation, fewer competing UI elements, and lower visual noise over decorative imagery, extra chrome, floating elements, or busy multi-module compositions.
Prefers layouts with even spacing, stable vertical rhythm, and balanced distribution of elements rather than top-heavy compositions, awkward empty areas, or crowded stacking.
Prefers a composed, premium, understated presentation with controlled contrast and a polished app-like feel rather than blunt, generic, mechanical, or overly aggressive styling.
